title: feat(website): new Apps page from website v2
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Part of #14472. Third slice after #15973 and #15983.

- Replaces the old Apps page with v2's: hero, "Most-used Pollen Pay apps" spotlight, and a searchable directory with category, platform and Pollen Pay filters kept in the URL.
- Adds the Apps hero and closing art. Main's `/apps` currently preloads hero images that don't exist yet.
- Deletes the old Apps page and the hooks, badge, back-to-top control and copy only it used.
- Every file matches `feat/website-v2`, except that main keeps a trimmed `layout.ts` for the old Community diary.

Verified locally: tsc, 66 tests, build. Desktop dark and 390px light screenshots are byte-identical to v2. The games filter shows 18 of 51, with no sideways scroll.

The spotlight uses the same weekly ranking as Home, so it doesn't depend on the Tinybird deployment 168 promotion.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: A bigger garden for apps
gist.blurb: The Apps page gets a new home: a spotlight for the most-used Pollen Pay apps and a directory you can actually sift through. The filters stay in the URL, so your carefully curated corner of the garden is easy to share.
gist.summary: Replaces the old Apps page with v2's hero and closing art, a weekly-ranked Pollen Pay spotlight, and a searchable directory whose category, platform, and Pollen Pay filters persist in the URL.
gist.impact: Visitors get a clearer way to discover popular apps, narrow the directory by category, platform, or Pollen Pay, and share a link to their filtered results.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Apps directory as a cozy garden of small app-shaped flower pots. Polli tends a search sign and three filter markers for category, platform, and Pollen Pay; a softly lit display highlights the most-used Pollen Pay apps. A tiny bookmark suggests shareable filtered URLs.
